verdict.rationale: Restate handlers can be triggered over HTTP, from typed clients in the app, or from Kafka topics, and any handler can act as a durable webhook endpoint with exactly-once processing and idempotency-key deduplication. Fan-out is shown only as in-code orchestration (one handler dispatching to many agents or services), not as a declarative event-to-many-subscribers mapping. Missing for 10: evidence of declarative trigger/subscription configuration, native one-event-to-many-functions fan-out (pub/sub-style), queue sources beyond Kafka, and independent hands-on corroboration.
